authority.authority_ref: Active Runbook Sentinel director goal in Codex task 019fd836-f77d-70f3-b529-fe691c8e6de2
authority.user_instruction: Continue selecting and shipping bounded evidence-driven checkpoints without routine approval while preserving the thesis, external-source gates, and security boundaries.

scope.objective: Produce and release a reproducible, dependency-free executable zipapp that preserves the exact bounded source-runtime behavior and frozen evaluation identity while excluding cache, secret, credential, approval, execution-authority, and non-runtime material.
forbidden_work: Connect to or mutate real operational infrastructure
Add, remove, or broaden an executor action or capability
Give the agent or model credentials, approval material, idempotency authority, or execution access
Weaken authorization, hashing, expiry, idempotency, replay protection, preconditions, postconditions, audit logging, evidence boundaries, or freshness rules
Add a package dependency, build backend, model, external service, secret, account, download, or externally controlled asset
Publish to a package registry or claim container, sandbox, or production-deployment equivalence
Change repository visibility, access, ownership, deterministic default, scenario expectations, or graders to favor the package
Use held-out packaged API/dashboard results as implementation feedback
Rewrite or discard unfavorable, failed, stale, blocked, or superseded evidence
reversible_actions: Freeze a project-authored package-content and parity contract
Add a deterministic standard-library ZIP builder and verifier
Make frozen-manifest loading archive-aware without changing manifest identity semantics
Build disposable and release-candidate pyz files under project and verification custody
Compare source and packaged CLI, evaluation, MCP, API, persistence, telemetry, and dashboard outputs
Attach a verified pyz and checksum file to the public GitHub release
Commit and publish a verified checkpoint
stop_conditions: New action, dependency, build backend, external asset, spend, paid service, secret, account, or download required

evidence: Public v0.0.10 local main, remote main, annotated tag, non-draft release, rendered pages, and release closure reconcile to 01791052b80748bb0f8e01c57152d00b53822aee
Fresh v0.0.10 orientation passes all 84 trials and every declared gate with zero model calls or cost
The public v0.0.10 release has zero attached package assets and no package-registry claim
The current environment has zipapp but no setuptools or wheel build backend
Two default zipapp builds differ, contain 17 pycache entries, and packaged evaluation fails because the frozen manifest is unavailable
The official Python 3.12.13 packaging specification source gate is ready and imports no external artifact
The first packaged held-out dashboard rendered Baseline 0010 while health and evaluation reported baseline-0011; publication is rejected.

units.purpose: Verify public v0.0.10, run a fresh orientation, inspect traces and release truth, measure the package gap, and gate official specifications
retained_failures: The first GitHub release-asset query had a transient API connection error; the identical read-only retry returned an empty asset list.
The first nested setuptools.build_meta spec probe raised because the parent setuptools package is absent; the corrected top-level probe established setuptools false, wheel false, and zipapp true.
The first official-page hash inventory used .NET methods unavailable in this PowerShell runtime and returned no evidence items; compatible SHA-256 hashing then captured all three live pages.
The default zipapp evaluation failed with FileNotFoundError for the frozen manifest; the full stderr is retained outside the repository and the failure is part of the discriminating gap.

units.purpose: Freeze exact package contents, reproducibility, source-parity surfaces, held-out boundary, and immutable pre-change evidence before implementation
evidence: eval/package-contract.json freezes the exact 21-entry allowlist, stable ZIP metadata, dependency-free artifact identity, parity surfaces, held-out boundary, and release gates
scripts/verify_package_contract.py passed the contract-only check and independently rejected the unfavorable v0.0.10 default zipapp
artifacts/verification/package-contract-freeze-baseline-0011.json binds the contract, validator, source manifest, source gate, gap, and pre-change control before candidate implementation
scripts/freeze_manifest.py now requires the package contract, complete packaged runtime surface, deterministic builder, and independent package validator

units.purpose: Implement one deterministic allowlist builder, archive-aware frozen-manifest loading, and focused development package parity
evidence: Two independent passing builds are byte-identical at SHA-256 2ce3147aaec755ab6ee72109c281e5f306ad9cb2d6f83963fc251d925e014f28 and independently satisfy the 21-entry archive contract
Source and package CLI help and the frozen development scenario match on outcome, diagnosis, proposal, missing evidence, retrieval identity, and decision identity
Source and package 84-attempt evaluations both pass every gate and match on all non-latency metric families
The initial reproducible archive's launcher ImportError remains retained; the generic absolute-import fix changed neither the frozen package contract nor any security boundary

units.purpose: Reveal held-out packaged surfaces once, run repeated independent builds and source/package comparisons, and select only a measured portability improvement
evidence: Source and package same-manifest evaluation results passed every gate and matched on all non-latency metric families
Packaged MCP passed with only three bounded diagnostic/read tools and no approval or execution authority
Packaged HTTP, approval, executor, replay, terminal postconditions, persistence, telemetry, and dashboard checks passed 49 of 50 assertions
The sole held-out failure was a visibly stale Baseline 0010 dashboard label while runtime health and evaluation reported baseline-0011
retained_failures: artifacts/verification/package-held-out-baseline-0011-attempt-001-failed.json retains the exact failed candidate, screenshot, source location, and rejected release disposition; the candidate and contract were not changed after reveal

units.purpose: Version, validate source and packaged real surfaces, reconcile records, clean-clone, review, merge, attach package and checksums, release, and verify the bounded checkpoint
outputs: baseline-0011 public release with verified portable artifact
retained_failures: Publication is excluded because UNIT-004 rejected the fixed candidate after its first held-out reveal.

changed_risks: Nondeterministic archive bytes preventing identity verification
Machine-local pycache, secrets, credentials, runtime state, or unrelated files entering the package
Packaged evaluation losing or misrepresenting frozen manifest identity
Source and packaged CLI, MCP, API, persistence, telemetry, or dashboard behavior diverging
An archive path weakening approval, policy, executor, or real-infrastructure boundaries
Package verification trusting self-reported metadata without checking entries and hashes
A favorable package smoke test masking held-out or repeated-build failure
required_checks: Exact public v0.0.10 identity and fresh orientation
Ready official-specification source gate with no imported asset
Frozen allowlisted archive entries, metadata, timestamps, permissions, and package manifest
Independent validator rejects extra, missing, reordered, timestamp-shifted, permission-shifted, hash-mismatched, cache, secret, or manifest-mismatched archives
Pre-change default zipapp nondeterminism, cache inclusion, and evaluation failure retained before implementation
Repeated independent candidate builds are byte-identical and package checksum is exact
Embedded frozen manifest matches the authoritative version-bound manifest
Source and package evaluation metrics and exact outcomes match on development and held-out splits
Unchanged agent purpose, three-action set, approval boundary, executor policy, API/MCP capabilities, and deterministic default

Source and package CLI, MCP, API, approval, executor, replay, dashboard, persistence, telemetry, tests, clean clone, GitHub review, merged main, release asset download, checksum, and rendered public pages
completed_checks: Public v0.0.10 release closure and clean authoritative main verified
Fresh 84-trial orientation passed every existing gate and is retained outside the repository
Public release asset count is zero; current release explicitly makes no package-registry or package-artifact claim
Default zipapp builds are runnable but byte-different, include 17 pycache entries, and cannot run frozen evaluation
Python 3.12.13 official packaging documentation source gate is ready for citation and project-authored implementation only

handoff.current_checkpoint: Public v0.0.10 is verified; BASELINE-0011 selects reproducible portable zipapp parity as its one bounded improvement.
handoff.next_action: Complete UNIT-002 by freezing the archive-content, reproducibility, source-parity, held-out, and pre-change package contract before implementation.
do_not_carry_forward: Do not add a build backend, package dependency, container base, or external asset.
Do not treat a runnable help command as package parity or reproducibility.
Do not use held-out packaged API/dashboard results as implementation feedback.
Do not broaden agent, approval, executor, credential, or real-infrastructure authority.
Do not rewrite unfavorable, failed, or superseded package evidence.

required_updates: ADRs if a package decision survives comparison
